The Python empty-model bypass is inconsistent with the candidate gateway resolver, which rejects an explicit empty model ID when it is not registered.

No full HTTP server or model-weight run was performed; the Python result uses the actual request protocol and serving base but a minimal pre-engine handler, which is sufficient to exercise the validation gate only.
